routes.name: Banana Ship
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Red Dwarf', then left after the 4th clip. Titanium bolts.

routes.name: Red Dwarf
routes.desc: Shares the first four clips with 'Banana Ship', then right along the crack. Rebolted with 8 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Tom's Pitch
routes.desc: Rebolted with titanium, except for the anchor, which is on 2 stainless steel glue-in bolts and 1 sling.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Rebolted with titanium, except for the anchor, which is on 2 stainless steel glue-in bolts and 1 sling.

routes.name: The Gecko / Viper
routes.desc: Slab start to powerful finish up tufas. Be careful nnot to break the stalactites at the start! 10 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Rocket Head
routes.desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasp nest after 5th bolt Climb along the bolts not the slings in the roof. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Acid-Mouth Wife
routes.desc: Be careful at the crux after the second clip, badly protected. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Satanic Alliance
routes.desc: Reachy start. Crux badly protected. Not rebolted with titanium. 3 stainless steel glue-ins, 1 titanium bolt at the crux.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium.
